## 12. Design Tokens yang Disarankan

> Berdasarkan data scan nyata — warna terbanyak digunakan dijadikan token.

```css
:root {
  /* ── Primary Color (dominan: #FFF, #FFF) ─── */
  --color-primary:        #FFF;
  --color-primary-light:  #047857;
  --color-primary-subtle: #D1FAE5;
  --color-primary-dark:   #065F46;

  /* ── Neutral (Slate) ────────────────── */
  --color-neutral-950:    #020617;
  --color-neutral-900:    #0F172A;
  --color-neutral-800:    #1E293B;
  --color-neutral-600:    #475569;
  --color-neutral-500:    #64748B;
  --color-neutral-400:    #94A3B8;
  --color-neutral-200:    #E2E8F0;
  --color-neutral-100:    #F1F5F9;
  --color-neutral-50:     #F8FAFC;

  /* ── Semantic ───────────────────────── */
  --color-success:        #FFF;
  --color-warning:        #F59E0B;
  --color-danger:         #E11D48;
  --color-info:           #0EA5E9;
  --color-accent:         #6366F1;

  /* ── Glassmorphism (dipakai di project ini) */
  --glass-bg:     rgba(255,255,255,0.72);
  --glass-border: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
  --glass-blur:   blur(20px) saturate(160%);

  /* ── Typography ─────────────────────── */
  --font-body:    "Inter", sans-serif;
  --font-display: "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif;

  /* ── Spacing (dari tw_spacing scan) ─── */
  --space-1:  0.25rem;
  --space-2:  0.5rem;
  --space-3:  0.75rem;
  --space-4:  1rem;
  --space-6:  1.5rem;
  --space-8:  2rem;

  /* ── Border Radius ──────────────────── */
  --radius-sm:   0.375rem;
  --radius-md:   0.5rem;
  --radius-lg:   0.75rem;
  --radius-xl:   1rem;
  --radius-full: 9999px;

  /* ── Shadow ─────────────────────────── */
  --shadow-sm:    0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.05);
  --shadow-card:  0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.06), 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0,0,0,.04);
  --shadow-modal: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
}
```

**Animasi yang sudah ada** (jangan duplikasi): `drift`, `tIn`, `tOut`, `toastIn`, `toastOut`
